hero.title: About Us
hero.description: A house of artisanal fashion, built in Denpasar by the hands of local craftspeople.

ourStory.heading: Our Story
ourStory.subheading: Rooted in Bali, Inspired by Purpose
ourStory.p1: Lindway is more than a brand—it's a lifestyle shaped by passion, purpose, and the vibrant soul of Bali. Based in Denpasar and proudly self-manufactured, Lindway is built by the hands of local artisans, blending creativity and community into every thread.
ourStory.p2: Our vision is to express beauty through thoughtful design—where color, pattern, texture, and form come together in refined harmony. Each creation is a reflection of our commitment to elegance, craftsmanship, and authentic storytelling.
ourStory.p3: We believe in fashion with intention. That means producing high-quality pieces that not only elevate personal style but also make a positive impact on our community, our environment, and the planet. Every product is made with care—thoughtfully designed, responsibly crafted, and tailored to meet both aesthetic and ethical standards.
ourStory.p4: At Lindway, fabric is treated as both material and muse. We carefully select only the finest textiles and ensure minimal waste by thoughtfully repurposing leftover fabric across our collections. It's a quiet nod to sustainability—woven into the essence of our brand.
ourStory.closing: With every piece, Lindway invites you to experience fashion that feels meaningful, mindful, and timeless.

artisanJourney.heading: Our Artisan Journey
artisanJourney.subheading: A Celebration of Craftsmanship and Culture
artisanJourney.p1: At Lindway, every piece tells a story—of heritage, artistry, and heartfelt creation. Crafted with great care and love, our collections are brought to life through the hands of local artisans, each product embodying the essence of Indonesian tradition with a modern twist.
artisanJourney.p2: From the refined beauty of manual and hand-guided embroidery to the expressive charm of hand-painted designs and the radiant sparkle of sequins, every Lindway creation is a tribute to traditional techniques.
artisanJourney.p3: Our menswear line showcases the timeless elegance of contemporary style, ornament, and the rich tradition of Bali, interpreted by local artisans. These pieces offer a fresh, sophisticated expression of cultural heritage—blending tradition with modern sensibility.
artisanJourney.p4: We embrace patch art using leftover materials, breathing new life into fabric remnants while committing to sustainability and honoring Indonesia's rich batik legacy.
artisanJourney.p5: Comfort and craftsmanship go hand in hand in our collections. Every stitch, brushstroke, and detail is infused with passion and purpose. Step into our world and discover the quiet luxury of slow fashion—where each thread carries the soul of its maker.

sustainabilityPromo.title: Discover Our Sustainability Principles
sustainabilityPromo.description: How we choose materials, treat offcuts, and pace production.

custom.label: Custom
custom.body: Most of what we make begins as a conversation. Measurements, motifs, a colour someone remembers from a ceremony — our made-to-order pieces are cut for one person rather than for a size chart. It is slower, and that is the point: nothing leaves the atelier until it fits the person who asked for it.

cultural.label: Cultural
cultural.body: Every technique we use — hand-guided embroidery, hand-painted fabric, sequin work, batik — is Indonesian, and is worked by artisans who learned it here. We treat those traditions as living craft rather than decoration, which means paying properly for the time they take and naming the hands that do them.

conscious.label: Conscious
conscious.body: We produce in small runs, choose fabrics that outlast a season, and turn offcuts into patch art rather than waste. Fashion with intention means accounting for what a garment costs the community and the island it was made on, not only what it costs to buy.

hero.title: Our Production
hero.description: Skilled hands, patience and purpose — how a Lindway piece is actually made.

ourProduction.processIntro: Every Lindway piece begins with skilled hands, patience, and purpose—carefully crafted through time-honored techniques, thoughtful design, and an unwavering commitment to exceptional quality and lasting elegance.
ourProduction.craftIntro: Traditional techniques, modern expression, and timeless beauty—each detail worked by an artisan who learned the craft here, in Bali.

design.title: Design & Consultation
design.body: Every piece starts on paper and, for made-to-order work, in conversation. Silhouette, motif and fabric are agreed before a single metre is cut, so nothing is decided after the fact.

fabric.title: Fabric Selection
fabric.body: Textiles are chosen for how they wear over years rather than seasons. We buy in quantities we can use, and what is left over is kept for patch work instead of discarded.

cutting.title: Cutting & Construction
cutting.body: Patterns are cut by hand in our Denpasar atelier. Because runs are small, the same maker usually carries a garment from cut to finish — which is what keeps the fit consistent.

embellishment.title: Embellishment
embellishment.body: Hand-guided embroidery, hand-painted fabric, sequin work and batik are added by artisans trained in each technique. This is the slowest stage and the one we never compress.

finishing.title: Finishing & Quality Check
finishing.body: Seams, linings and closures are checked piece by piece. Anything that does not pass goes back to the maker rather than into the box.

packing.title: Packing & Dispatch
packing.body: Orders are wrapped and dispatched from Denpasar, with a tracking number sent as soon as the parcel is on its way.

hero.title: Sustainability
hero.description: Thoughtful materials, timeless craftsmanship, and pieces built to outlast a season.

sustainability.statement: Fashion should leave something behind worth keeping—not unnecessary waste.
sustainability.pillarsDescription: Our commitment to sustainability is built on thoughtful choices—from responsible materials and skilled craftsmanship to timeless designs made to last.

materials.title: Thoughtful Materials
materials.body: We carefully select high-quality fabrics that are durable, comfortable, and made to be worn for years. Every material is chosen with longevity and responsible sourcing in mind.

craftsmanship.title: Timeless Craftsmanship
craftsmanship.body: Every Lindway piece is crafted with precision and care by skilled artisans, combining traditional techniques with refined construction to create garments that stand the test of time.

longevity.title: Conscious Longevity
longevity.body: We believe the most sustainable wardrobe is one built to last. By creating timeless designs instead of chasing trends, we encourage mindful purchasing and lasting wear.

sustainability.journalDescription: Go beyond the label with editorial stories about craftsmanship, circular thinking, and the lasting value of timeless fashion.

hero.title: Our Fabrics
hero.description: The textiles behind every Lindway piece, and what each one is best suited to.

ourFabrics.intro: At Lindway, fabric is more than just a material — it's the beginning of every story we tell. We choose each fabric with care to ensure it reflects the values of comfort, craftsmanship, and artistry that define our brand.

fabrics.cotton: Light, airy, and breathable — ideal for warm days and flowing silhouettes. A favorite for our everyday wear collection.
fabrics.cottonVoile: Light as air and beautifully breathable, cotton voile is a semi-sheer fabric with a smooth, crisp finish. Perfect for soft linings, flowy blouses, and delicate layering—cool, comfortable, and effortlessly elegant.
fabrics.cottonLining: Our go-to choice for inner layers. Lightweight, breathable, and skin-friendly, cotton lining ensures comfort without compromising the drape or design of your outer garment.
fabrics.cottonViscose: A breathable blend that combines the softness of cotton with the graceful drape of viscose. Light, comfortable, and easy to wear—ideal for everyday pieces with a polished finish.
fabrics.sifon: Delicately sheer and feather-light, sifon (chiffon) adds a layer of softness and romance to any design. Perfect for flowy overlays, sleeves, and feminine silhouettes that move with grace.
fabrics.linenCotton: A natural blend that's breathable like linen and soft like cotton. Its slightly textured weave gives off an effortlessly relaxed charm—perfect for warm days and timeless wardrobe staples.
fabrics.organzaSemiSilk: An elevated take on classic organza—this semi-silk version is softer, smoother, and more wearable. It holds its shape while remaining gentle against the skin, making it ideal for sophisticated layering and modern kebaya styles.
fabrics.brocade: Luxurious and textured, brocade is a woven fabric rich with intricate patterns. Often used in our occasionwear, it brings a sense of tradition and grandeur—each thread telling a story.
fabrics.jacquard: Woven with detailed patterns directly into the fabric, jacquard adds subtle structure and quiet elegance. Ideal for statement pieces that stand out with refined craftsmanship.
